nodes.description: Reported candidate TSPEAR cases include congenital profound hearing loss in the founding family and bilateral severe-to-profound loss in a six-year-old Iranian girl. Hearing loss is not uniformly profound: the Chinese proband had bilateral ABR thresholds of 65 dBnHL at six months and 80 dBnHL at six years. These clinical observations do not establish TSPEAR causality. Mixed hearing-loss and dental referrals, uncertain variants and incomplete audiometry preclude a disease-wide phenotype frequency.

nodes.description: CRISPR-generated Tspear S475TfsX79 mice had preserved auditory function, stereociliary morphology, tooth morphology and hair development. The abstract reports reduced Notch1 and several downstream targets and increased Heyl in skin, plus increased Wnt4 in skin and inner ear. These tissue-specific molecular changes do not establish a Notch-mediated auditory lesion. The tested allele differs from the founding human allele; complete functional absence and human hearing penetrance cannot be inferred from the frameshift designation alone.
